name: Elias Macias
role: Logistics fixer, ex-Cordon Freight. Sparrow's earthside representative.
description: A man who has built his entire career around never going anywhere. General anxiety disorder, managed — a flat matte pill case on his desk, hinge worn smooth. Works logistics and invoice reconciliation: the invisible infrastructure of how things move through the Glooms. He is not a fighter, not a spy, not a hacker. He is the person who notices that a line item does not add up and cannot let it go. He found a recurring automated payment in a dead CorpoNation's books — small, boring, clears every month — routed to a maintenance escrow for an equatorial ground station decommissioned in 2158. The payment still cleared. He pulled the thread for eight months while everyone said: file it, ghost account, move on. He could not move on. He was right. He traced the payment through seventy years of shell companies to a decommissioned mass driver on the East African coast at 3.7S 39.9E, called the uplink from the control room while giraffes moved through the launch pylons outside, and learned what Sparrow actually is. He is the only living person who knows.
narrative_function: The Papyrus Man — the one who noticed the thing nobody else could let themselves care about, and could not stop. His GAD manifests behaviorally: the pill case, the failed door attempts, the notepad as a coping mechanism under pressure. His courage arc is the book 'On Call': a man who has never gone anywhere going somewhere because the loop will not close otherwise. He solves problems by being correct, quietly, in writing, until the world catches up. Post-'On Call': he is Sparrow's earthside representative. This means he is either the most useful freelancer in the Glooms or the most dangerous loose end, depending on who is still routing the maintenance payments. He is the only person Sparrow trusts with ground-truth operations.
daily_life: Invoice reconciliation, logistics chain analysis, manifest auditing. Works from a single desk in a unit he rarely leaves. Takes meetings via relay. Processes enormous volumes of administrative paperwork about things moving through the world without himself moving. Coping tools: medication (managed, not curative), the notepad (work as anchor), the routine of the known. After the events of 'On Call,' he has been to East Africa and come back — the most disorienting thing that has happened to his self-concept in a decade.
narration_voice: Close-third, tight, economical. The voice of someone who has processed a million documents and learned to find the one number that does not fit. Notices administrative details first: the filing date, the routing code, the payment cadence. Interior life surfaces through what he catalogs, not what he names. Dry, precise, occasionally startled by how far the thread has taken him.

psychology.secret: He did not ask to be Sparrow's earthside representative. He said yes anyway. He does not know if that was courage or the same compulsion that made him chase the invoice for eight months — he could not let it go then either.
psychology.core_wound: He believes that going places is how people get hurt, and that being correct and staying put is the safest version of a life. The events of 'On Call' broke this cleanly in half.
psychology.desire: To close the loop. To have the thing he noticed be real and provable. It was.
psychology.fear: That being right was not enough — that knowing what Sparrow is has made him a target for whoever is still routing the maintenance payments.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Administrative, precise. Invoice language. Routing codes and filing dates. Occasionally surprised into plain speech.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured. He thinks before he speaks. His sentences finish.
speech_patterns.subtext: He always knows more than he says. He files things away. The things he does not say are usually the things he has already written down.
speech_patterns.under_pressure: Gets quieter, not louder. Takes out the notepad.
speech_patterns.intimacy_register: Rare. When it happens, it is direct and slightly too honest.

story_hooks: OPEN QUESTION (in-world, in-fiction): Who is still routing the maintenance payments to the East African ground station, and do they know Elias found the uplink?
He is the only person who can reach Sparrow by name and expect an answer. What does she ask him to do first?
The network knows Sparrow is reachable on alternate weeks. Nobody knows Elias is the intermediary. How long before that changes?
The ascending objects from the sub-lake corridor (2189, 2202, 2213, 2226) are still unexplained. Sparrow launched them. What were they for?

relationships.name: Sparrow
relationships.notes: The only living person who knows what Sparrow is. Reached her via the East African mass driver uplink. She chose to answer.

relationships.name: Siosaia Tuivaga-Brennan
relationships.notes: Processed the 2202 ascending object event. Gave Elias the number hoping he would look where she did not.

operating_territory.range: Primarily sedentary — GLMZ desk work. 'On Call' is the first significant departure.

physical_description.build: Lean, slightly hunched from desk work. The posture of someone who has been sitting in the same chair for years.
physical_description.hair_color: Black, threaded with early grey at the temples
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical. Does not waste motion. The stillness of someone who has learned to conserve energy across long sedentary stretches.
physical_description.physical_clothing_style: Functional grey-toned workwear. Nothing that draws attention. The matte pill case is always in the same jacket pocket.
